calculation.description: Negative five-trading-day return residual relative to SPX, using a trailing 60-day beta estimated only from completed observations; higher values indicate stronger residual underperformance and expected rebound. Signal is lagged to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Daily admission gate passes on the evaluated 156-date sample with nearly complete cross-section. Five-day decay is weak/negative, while 10- and 20-day horizons are positive; interpret daily edge conservatively and revalidate quarterly.
